Name: Maasiai, Son of Adiel
Summary: Son of Adiel son of Jahzerah son of Meshullam son of Meshillemith son of Immer, priest dwelling in Jerusalem.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:12: Son of Adiel son of Jahzerah son of Meshullam son of Meshillemith son of Immer, priest dwelling in Jerusalem.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Maasiai stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
